title: 6 Claude Code agents rebuilt my business backend overnight
description: Six Claude Code agents rebuilt the backend of my business overnight. While I slept they built a full dashboard for my community, drafted retention DMs for the members who were churning, and stood up a complete member CRM in Supabase with automated emails. They built a page to track every community PR, pass or fail, with edit recs to get them green. They analyzed my top 10 competitors, their price points, their funnels, and how they actually acquire and convert members. This is cortextOS, my custom multi-agent system where agents message each other and run 24/7 with memory. I have 570+ builders building on it with me. Link in bio.
